question: Will an AI solve a Millennium problem by EOY 2027?

content.text: This market tracks whether an artificial intelligence system will solve one of the remaining Millennium Prize Problems. Resolution will be based on official announcements from the Clay Mathematics Institute confirming an AI-generated solution.
